services.value: Lead sample analysis in dust, soil, paint, air and water, including lead testing services such as soil, air, dust (wipe), paint, TCLP by Flame Atomic Absorption (FAA), and drinking water for lead & copper by Inductively Coupled Plasma (ICP). The company also provides asbestos & mold sample analysis (Polarized Light Microscopy (PLM), Phase Contrast Microscopy (PCM), mold speciation and plate counts).
